title: Exact pro-etale pushforward for finite finitely presented morphisms
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] which is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], direct image of abelian sheaves is exact:
$$f_*:\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\mathrm{proet}})\longrightarrow\operatorname{Ab}(Y_{\mathrm{proet}}).$$
Thus every short exact sequence $0\to F'\to F\to F''\to0$ of abelian sheaves remains short exact after $f_*$. More generally, let $R_Y,R_X$ be sheaves of commutative rings on these sites, equipped with a ring map $f^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$. The module direct image, with its $R_Y$-action defined through $R_Y\to f_*R_X$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction], is exact on the whole category of $R_X$-module sheaves. No constructibility, torsion, or flatness hypothesis on the modules is required.

source.place: Tag 09A8, Lemma proetale-lemma-finite. The module assertion is its immediate consequence by forgetting module structures; exactness of a sequence of module sheaves is exactness of the underlying abelian sheaves.

proof.text: Let $W$ be an object of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$. Cover $Y$ by affine opens $\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq Y$ and consider the affine opens $W'=\operatorname{Spec}A'\subseteq W$ whose image lies in one such $\operatorname{Spec}A$. Each composite $W'\to W\to Y$ is weakly etale by [lem-weil-pbc-weakly-etale-source-locality] (applied to the open cover of $W$ by these $W'$), so $W'$ is an object and $W'\to W$ a morphism of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site]. These $W'$ form a basis of the topology of $W$, so every affine open $V\subseteq W$, being quasi-compact, is a finite union of such $W'$ contained in $V$: the family is a pro-etale covering of $W$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering]. For such $W'$ over $\operatorname{Spec}A$, the finite morphism $f$ has $f^{-1}(\operatorname{Spec}A)=\operatorname{Spec}B$ with $B$ a finite $A$-module [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and $A\to B$ is of finite presentation by [lem-weil-pbc-lfp-affine-opens-finite-presentation], since $f$ is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. As $W'\to Y$ factors through $\operatorname{Spec}A$, the universal property of fibre products gives $u_f(W')=X\times_YW'\cong\operatorname{Spec}(A'\otimes_AB)$.

source.place: Tag 09A8, proof, first sentence: work Zariski locally and write X=Spec(A), Z=Spec(B) with B finite of finite presentation; carried out here for the affine objects of Y_proet lying over affine opens of Y

proof.text: For an affine object $W'=\operatorname{Spec}A'$ of step 1, choose a faithfully flat ind-etale $A'$-algebra $D$ whose spectrum is w-contractible, using [lem-weil-pbc-source-wcontractible-extension]. Ind-etale maps are weakly etale and weakly etale maps compose [lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-stability], so $\operatorname{Spec}D\to W'\to Y$ is weakly etale and $\operatorname{Spec}D$ is an object of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$. Since $A'\to D$ is faithfully flat, $\operatorname{Spec}D\to W'$ is surjective and affine; for an affine open $V\subseteq W'$ its inverse image is affine and maps onto $V$, so the single map is a pro-etale covering [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering]. Put $C=D\otimes_{A'}(A'\otimes_AB)=D\otimes_AB$. The images of finitely many $A$-module generators of $B$ generate $C$ as a $D$-module, and tensoring a presentation $B=A[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(g_1,\dots,g_m)$ with $D$ gives $C=D[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(g_1,\dots,g_m)$; so $C$ is finite and finitely presented over $D$. Hence $C$ is w-contractible by [lem-ce-finite-finitely-presented-wcontractible]; this includes $C=0$ (empty fibre). Finally $u_f(\operatorname{Spec}D)=X\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}D\cong\operatorname{Spec}C$ by step 1 and associativity of fibre products.

source.place: Tag 09A8, proof, second and third sentences: the construction of Proposition proposition-find-w-contractible gives A -> D faithfully flat ind-etale with D w-contractible; D tensor_A B is w-contractible by Lemma lemma-finite-finitely-presented-over-w-contractible (Tag 0986)

proof.text: Let $0\to F'\to F\xrightarrow{\pi}F''\to0$ be a short exact sequence in $\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\mathrm{proet}})$. By the direct-image definition [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], $(f_*F)(\operatorname{Spec}D)=F(u_f(\operatorname{Spec}D))$, and $u_f(\operatorname{Spec}D)$ is an object of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ whose scheme is isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}C$ with $C$ w-contractible (step 2). The epimorphism $\pi$ is locally surjective by [lem-weil-pbc-site-abelian-sheaf-epi-locally-surjective]; hence its underlying map of set-valued sheaves is locally surjective, and [lem-weil-pbc-source-affine-wcontractible-evaluation] says it is surjective on $u_f(\operatorname{Spec}D)$-sections. Thus every section of $(f_*F'')(\operatorname{Spec}D)$ lifts to $(f_*F)(\operatorname{Spec}D)$.

source.place: Tag 09A8, proof, fourth and fifth sentences: f_* F evaluated at U=Spec(D) equals F evaluated at V=Spec(D tensor_A B), and evaluation at V is exact

proof.text: Let $W$ be any object of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and $s\in(f_*F'')(W)$. With the affine $W'\subseteq W$ of step 1 and the $\operatorname{Spec}D_{W'}\to W'$ of step 2, the composites $\operatorname{Spec}D_{W'}\to W$ form a pro-etale covering of $W$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering]: an affine open $V\subseteq W$ is a finite union of such $W'\subseteq V$, and each $\operatorname{Spec}D_{W'}$ is affine and maps onto $W'$. By step 3, $s|_{\operatorname{Spec}D_{W'}}$ lifts for every $W'$, so $f_*\pi$ is locally surjective, hence an epimorphism of $\operatorname{Ab}(Y_{\mathrm{proet}})$ by [lem-weil-pbc-site-abelian-sheaf-epi-locally-surjective]. Kernels of abelian sheaves are computed sectionwise [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful], and $(f_*G)(V)=G(u_f(V))$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], so $0\to f_*F'\to f_*F\to f_*F''$ is exact sectionwise, hence exact. Therefore $f_*:\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\mathrm{proet}})\to\operatorname{Ab}(Y_{\mathrm{proet}})$ is exact.

source.place: Tag 09A8, proof, third sentence: 'We may check exactness of a sequence of sheaves by evaluating on U = Spec(D)', written out for covers of every object of Y_proet

proof.text: For sheaves of modules over arbitrary commutative ring sheaves $R_Y,R_X$, the underlying abelian direct image is the same sectionwise functor by [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image] and [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], while the $R_Y$-action is the one induced from $f^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$ through the module adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction]. The forgetful functor from module sheaves to abelian sheaves is faithful and exact by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful]. Hence the underlying sequence after $f_*$ is short exact by the preceding steps, and faithfulness reflects its exactness in the module category. No constructibility, torsion, or flatness of the modules is used.

lean.statement: theorem finite_fp_proEtale_pushforward_exact {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] : PreservesFiniteLimits (proEtaleSheafDirectImage f AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (proEtaleSheafDirectImage f AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ∧ ∀ (R_Y : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (R_X : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_Y ⟶ R_X), PreservesFiniteLimits (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u + 1} (F := proEtaleBaseChange f) (J := ProEt.topology Y) (K := ProEt.topology X) (S := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Y) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R_Y) (R := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R_X) ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Y) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).map ((proEtaleSheafAdjunction f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).homEquiv R_Y R_X c))) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u + 1} (F := proEtaleBaseChange f) (J := ProEt.topology Y) (K := ProEt.topology X) (S := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Y) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R_Y) (R := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R_X) ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Y) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).map ((proEtaleSheafAdjunction f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).homEquiv R_Y R_X c)))
